'''ZK-094R''' was an elite [[Skytrooper]], a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Eternal Empire]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]], that was designated as the command unit for the [[Belsavis shield bunker|shield bunker]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] that supported the Eternal Empire's [[Belsavis Star Fortress|Star Fortress]] in orbit.<ref name="Destroy" /> Around [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> ZK-094R was destroyed by [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]] and the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[K'krohl]], who invaded the bunker and destroyed it with explosives.<ref name="Destroy" />

==Behind the scenes==
ZK-094R was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online rolepalying video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a 2015 Digital Expansion.<ref name="Destroy" />
